part2.title: Collaborative Task - Different Holidays
part2.examinerSetup: Now, in this part of the test, you are going to talk together. Here are some pictures that show different holidays. Do you like these different holidays? Say why or why not. I'll say that again. Do you like these different holidays? Say why or why not. Alright, now talk together.

turns.speaker: A
turns.goal: ask the other candidate whether they like camping

turns.speaker: B
turns.goal: answer the camping question and give a reason
turns.virtualFallback: No, I don't, because I might get bitten by mosquitoes.

turns.speaker: A
turns.goal: respond about camping and ask about beach holidays
turns.virtualFallback: I agree because useful things are not always easy to find when camping. Do you like beach holidays?

turns.speaker: B
turns.goal: answer about beach holidays and invite a response
turns.virtualFallback: Yes, I like beach holidays unless the beach is crowded. What about you?

turns.speaker: A
turns.goal: give an opinion about hiking holidays
turns.virtualFallback: I like hiking best because I get to spend time with my family.

turns.speaker: B
turns.goal: ask whether beach holidays are fun
turns.virtualFallback: Do you think beach holidays are fun?
criteria: asks for an opinion about beach holidays

turns.speaker: A
turns.goal: answer about beach holidays and ask for the partner's opinion
turns.virtualFallback: I only like beach holidays when the beach is not crowded. What do you think?

turns.speaker: B
turns.goal: respond about beach holidays and ask about mountain holidays
turns.virtualFallback: Yes, because I get to go swimming. Do you think holidays in the mountains are boring?

turns.speaker: A
turns.goal: give a short initial answer about mountain holidays
turns.virtualFallback: Yes, they can be boring sometimes.

turns.speaker: B

turns.virtualFallback: You need to climb and find your own supplies, even though the air is fresh. What do you think?

turns.speaker: A
turns.goal: respond with a positive reason for mountain holidays
turns.virtualFallback: I don't think they are boring because you can play in the snow with your friends.
